CustomField.description: How long the customer's session is held open when we hand them to DocuSign, in minutes. The normal idle window is five minutes and only slides while our page is open, so without this a customer who takes longer than five minutes to read and sign comes back unrecognised. Still capped by Session_Hard_Expiry__c. Must also be added to the SELECT in ADHA_JourneyController.settings() or it reads as null.
CustomField.label: Signing Session Minutes
